artworks.title: Landscape with Figures
artworks.artist: Jacques Charles Bar
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of James A. Bergquist in honor of Jamie Gabbarelli
artworks.description: The image shows a view from an elevated position overlooking a landscape with lush surroundings. Trees obscure the horizon, creating a backdrop of dark foliage. Fine brushstrokes detail the foliage, stone structure, and ground. A pool of water reflects the scene, balancing the composition. Figures are depicted near a stone structure and water. In the distance, a pathway is bordered by trees, and a person walks away. The color palette is primarily monochrome, with soft tonal contrasts creating depth.

artworks.title: Jupiter and Juno
artworks.artist: Johann Gottlieb Prestel, after Pietro da Cortona
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 26.7 × 20.5 cm (10 1/2 × 8 1/16 in.), cut to platemark
artworks.creditLine: Gift of James A. Bergquist in honor of Jamie Gabbarelli
artworks.description: This is a drawing of mythological figures in a celestial scene. The drawing features several figures gathered amidst clouds. One figure, an imposing male, crowned and muscular, dominates the scene. Surrounding him are other male figures integrated with the cloud forms. A female figure on the right appears to be in flight or supported by air, reaching out towards the central male figure. The lower portion of the artwork shows a hint of a natural landscape with clouds and trees. The drawing is executed with precision, using ink to provide detail and shading.

artworks.title: Venus Commanding Vulcan to Make Arms for Aeneas
artworks.artist: Johann Gottlieb Prestel, after Pietro da Cortona
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint printed in brown on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 27.3 × 20 cm (10 3/4 × 7 7/8 in.) cut to platemark
artworks.creditLine: Gift of James A. Bergquist in honor of Jamie Gabbarelli
artworks.description: This is a drawing of mythological figures and symbolic scenes. The composition is centered around a large, oval-shaped motif that features a reclining female figure draped in flowing garments, partially exposed, who is positioned on a cloud. In her hand is a shield, and she appears to be interacting with a cherubic child to her right holding a helmet adorned with a crest. Below her is a muscular male figure, also reclining, with an ornate shield and a bundle of spears or staves nearby. The background contains swirling clouds and architectural details. The drawing has muted tones and intricate linework.

artworks.title: Adonias Imploring the Grace of Solomon or Jeroboam Kneeling before Rehoboam
artworks.artist: Charles-Paul-Jean-Baptiste de Bourgevin Vialart de Saint-Morys, after Amico Aspertini (attributed to; formerly after Raphael)
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint printed in brown on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of James A. Bergquist in honor of Jamie Gabbarelli
artworks.description: This is a drawing of several figures interacting with each other in a classical style. The scene depicts a seated figure on the left reaching towards a kneeling figure, who is extending a hand towards the seated figure. To the right, several other figures are positioned in various postures of observation or contemplation. The drawing is rendered in fine lines, with a light and airy composition, emphasizing the details of the drapery and the gestures of the figures. The entire scene conveys a sense of narrative and historical or mythological significance.

artworks.title: Psyche Carried by Zephyr to the Palace Built by Cupid
artworks.artist: Francois-Xavier Vispre, after Angelica Kauffmann (attributed to)
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint printed in brown on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of James A. Bergquist in honor of Jamie Gabbarelli
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three winged figures within a circular frame. One figure is draped in flowing garments, supported by the other two figures. The background features swirling clouds. The illustration is characterized by delicate line work and subtle shading.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Soldier
artworks.artist: Unknown 19th Century
artworks.medium: daguerreotype with applied color
artworks.creditLine: Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated in a formal military uniform with decorative elements. He is positioned with his right arm on a table and his left hand lightly clasping his right arm. His facial expression is subtle with lips closed and a slight curve to his eyebrows. He is dressed in a 19th-century military style uniform with shoulder epaulettes and buttons. The man is seated next to a table with small items and holds a baton or rolled-up document in his right hand. The background is plain and neutral, and the image is enclosed within an ornate frame with floral patterns.

artworks.title: Studies of a Youth Pulling Ropes (recto); Faint Study of a Youth Pulling a Rope (verso)
artworks.artist: Aurelio Lomi
artworks.medium: black and white chalk on blue laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of several figures in dynamic motion. The drawing, done on a bluish-grey paper, depicts sketchy and loosely rendered figures with limbs and torsos in different positions. The central figure is more detailed, with bent knees and arms that suggest movement. Light, shadow, and line contours accentuate muscular forms and postures. Other figures are drawn with lighter strokes. The composition conveys a study of human anatomy and movement.

artworks.title: American Scene
artworks.artist: Thomas Leeson Rowbotham
artworks.medium: gray wash with scratching out on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a rocky slope leading down to a valley between mountains. The horizon is high in the scene, with mist-covered peaks in the distance. The sun is visible, casting a soft glow over the mountain tops. The painting features fluid brushstrokes, creating a dramatic atmosphere. The color palette is monochrome, with blacks, grays, and whites providing contrast. Two figures are on the rocky terrain, one standing with a staff and the other seated, both looking towards a waterfall in the distance. Rocks, sparse vegetation, cliffs, and a lone tree can be seen in the scene.

artworks.title: Mrs. Anne Walbanke-Childers
artworks.artist: George Richmond
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite with gouache and gum arabic on wove paper, laid down on card
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman from the waist up. She has delicate features, fair skin, and dark brown hair styled in a middle parting and held in a bun. She wears an off-the-shoulder black dress with a bow, a pink shawl on her left arm, and holds a folded fan in her right hand. A bracelet is on her right wrist, and a ring is on one of her left fingers. In the background, there is a cloudy sky with brownish foliage to the left and a vase of colorful flowers partially hidden behind a green curtain to the right, all painted in an impressionistic style.

artworks.title: Durham Castle and Framwellgate Bridge from the Banks of the River Wear
artworks.artist: Thomas Hearne
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper, laid down
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Donald Stone in honor of Gabriel Naughton
artworks.description: The image shows a castle on a rocky outcrop to the right with a bridge over the water to the left. The horizon is low, and the sky has pink and blue hues. The color palette includes pastels and earthy tones. The scene shows reflections in the water and features delicate brushwork.

artworks.title: Y aun no se van! (And Still They Don't Go!)
artworks.artist: Francisco Goya
artworks.medium: etching, aquatint, and engraving with burnishing on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of several distorted humanoid figures trying to lift a large slab. The figures are emaciated and twisted, with exaggerated features. They appear to be struggling as they interact with the heavy stone block. The composition conveys tension and intense physical effort, with the figures' bodies contorted and muscles strained. The artwork features strong contrasts between light and dark areas to highlight the figures and the weight of the block.

artworks.title: Harlequin as a Painter
artworks.artist: Francesco Bartolozzi, after Giovanni Domenico Ferretti
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an artist at work. The scene depicts a person sitting at a chair, leaning over another individual to paint their portrait. The artist uses a brush and holds a pot. Several pottery items are placed around the figures, including a pitcher spilling liquid onto the floor. An easel in the middle displays a human figure portrait. The drawing showcases varied textures and intricate linework for depth and shading.

artworks.title: Harlequin as Lacemaker
artworks.artist: Francesco Bartolozzi, after Giovanni Domenico Ferretti
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image features two people in full-body view. One person is seated wearing an elaborate gown, bonnet, and a mask with exaggerated eyes. They hold a decorative bag on their lap. The other person stands with one arm bent and the other holding a handheld mirror. They wear a fitted gown with intricate details. The background is a simple textured backdrop with Italian text in the lower part of the image.

artworks.title: Harlequin as Crippled Soldier
artworks.artist: Francesco Bartolozzi, after Giovanni Domenico Ferretti
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
plate: 40.6 × 31 cm (16 × 12 3/16 in.)
sheet: 40.9 × 31 cm (16 1/8 × 12 3/16 in.), cut within platemark
artworks.description: The image shows two figures, a man and a woman. The man is standing with crutches and wearing a detailed uniform with a sword, while the woman stands gracefully holding a basket. The background shows a cloudy sky and a landscape.

artworks.title: Harlequin Unmasked
artworks.artist: Francesco Bartolozzi, after Giovanni Domenico Ferretti
artworks.medium: etching and engraving
artworks.description: The image shows two full-body figures interacting. The figure on the left has long, curly hair and is wearing a long dress with voluminous sleeves. This person appears to be pulling on the garment of the figure on the right. The figure on the right is slightly bent forward, wearing a wide-brimmed hat that partially obscures their face. This figure is dressed in layered garments, including a cloak and striped leggings. Their shoes have pronounced buckles. The setting is an indeterminate interior space with a textured background. There is no visible jewelry or objects being held by either figure. At the bottom of the image, there is a caption in Italian.

artworks.title: Der Triumph der Omphale (The Triumph of Omphale)
artworks.artist: Johann Peter Pichler, after Alessandro Turchi, called Orbetto
artworks.medium: mezzotint on laid paper, laid down
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a group of figures posed in various positions. In the center, a muscular man is seated holding a bow with his gaze down. Surrounding him are additional figures - to his right, a cherubic figure with wings, and to his left and in front of him, three standing figures partially draped in classical garb. Another person sits on the right, leaning slightly forward. The standing individuals are elegantly clothed in flowing garments and have intricate hairstyles. One of them seems to be holding an arrow, which might be intended for the central figure. The background is a neutral gradient darkening towards the top, and there is a large draped curtain on the left. The image is monochromatic.

artworks.title: Der rasende Herkules (Raging Hercules)
artworks.artist: Johann Peter Pichler, after Alessandro Turchi, called Orbetto
artworks.medium: mezzotint on laid paper, laid down
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: This is a painting featuring dynamic figures interacting. The central figure is holding a lifeless child over his shoulders, surrounded by various women expressing concern and despair. The setting implies turmoil and helplessness, portrayed with fine detailing, expressive forms, and chiaroscuro. The style is reminiscent of Peter Paul Rubens.

artworks.title: The Discovery of Achilles among the Daughters of Lycomedes
artworks.artist: Sir James Thornhill
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brush and brown wash, heightened with white gouache, over red chalk, on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring numerous figures in a historical setting. The composition includes figures engaged in various activities, with a central figure holding a spear and shield. The detailed linework emphasizes dynamic poses and expressions. Architectural elements like columns and arches are visible in the background. Muted tones and shading add depth to the scene. The intricate details convey a rich story in a classical style.

artworks.title: A Grotto (The Stables of the Villa Maecenas, Tivoli?)
artworks.artist: Francis Place
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a tunnel-like perspective looking through an archway at what seems to be an ancient, ruin-like structure. The horizon is not visible, indicating an enclosed space, with walls and arches framing the scene. The brushstrokes are loose and sketchy, suggesting an unfinished or impressionistic style. The color palette consists of sepia tones, ranging from dark browns to light creams. Close to us are dark shading areas suggesting uneven flooring or rocks, while beyond, light highlights parts of the walls and a passage leading to another open archway. The texture and play of light and shadow suggest depth and dimension within the confined space.

artworks.title: A Shepherd Sleeping while His Dog Guards His Flock
artworks.artist: Heinrich Carl Reinhold
artworks.medium: etching on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a shepherd sleeping against a grassy hillock on the right side, with a dog standing nearby. Several sheep are scattered around the landscape, with a group gathered on a rise in the center. In the background, there are rolling hills and a vast sky filled with clouds. The sky occupies a significant portion of the image. The engraving technique is used to create details and depth in the scene. The artwork is monochromatic, using shades of gray to depict light and shadow, enhancing the serene quality of the pastoral scene.

artworks.title: A Shepherd Scolding His Dog for Letting His Sheep Run Away
artworks.artist: Heinrich Carl Reinhold
artworks.medium: etching on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a pastoral scene with a shepherd, dog, and sheep in the foreground. Trees and foliage are on the right side, and rolling hills are in the background. The horizon shows more trees and rooftops of buildings. The engraving is detailed with intricate lines and a monochromatic palette of black, gray, and white.

artworks.title: A Harvest Scene with Straw Hats Lying in a Field
artworks.artist: Heinrich Carl Reinhold, after Friedrich Philipp Reinhold
artworks.medium: etching on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a river winding through it, hills in the distance, a horizon midway up the image, and a sky meeting the terrain. The artwork is composed of fine lines creating texture and depth. Closest to us are round shapes resembling bundles or sacks and a stick or staff. Further away, figures are by the river. The scene transitions from dark grass to lighter marks toward the sky, forming a monochromatic color palette.

artworks.title: A Young Couple under a Large Wicker Basket
artworks.artist: Heinrich Carl Reinhold, after Friedrich Philipp Reinhold
artworks.medium: etching on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a figure seated on stone steps, partially obscured by a large, basket-like structure. Stone pillars flank the figure, with foliage in the background. A path leads to a rustic fence that climbs a hill, and mountains are in the far distance under a light sky. The artwork is done in a monochromatic palette with intricate lines and cross-hatching techniques.

artworks.title: A Group of Peasants Loading Hay onto Boats
artworks.artist: Heinrich Carl Reinhold, after Friedrich Philipp Reinhold
artworks.medium: etching on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a pastoral scene with a river, figures engaged in various activities, distant hills, faint outlines of structures, a detailed and precise style typical of late 18th to early 19th-century etchings, and a monochromatic color palette in black and white. Trees, clouds, and the river add to the composition.
